info.name: SCCボイス
info.description: SCCボイス (SCC-Voice): Konami-style SCC+ sound cartridge extended with two identical sample voices A and B (MSM5205-compatible ADPCM, RAW8/RAW4, 255-byte FIFOs, SCC-style period counter, ROM fill with loops, click-free loop override), software ADSR/modulation, dedicated Sallen-Key output filter.

SCCVoice.id: SCCボイス Cartridge with expanded RAM
